## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 20, 2026 - Aug 5, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _ubaidullah md._, Jul 20, 2026, 1/5: "I deposited funds on slice savings account with the idea to save more but due to regular transactions they disabled my incoming transactions and adding funds to savings was frozen. This was very inconvenient as I had to withdraw my funds from the account due to safety reasons. Even after sending out my bank statements via email as proof they refused to unfreeze my savings account. Very disappointed with the customer retention policy and i conclude this app to be unreliable for long term use."
            2. _Invitation code- 64LQDM_, Aug 5, 2026, 5/5: "I love🍁 the app! It’s soo💿 much faster to download now and feels noticeably more stable in daily use. Earlier, syncing🥰 would trigger almost every time you opened the app or made even a small change, which slowed everything down. Now it feels smooth, responsive, and reliable, making the whole experience far more convenient and enjoyable. Even stopping an entry took extra seconds, and those were added too.The app would freeze during syncing, making it impossible to use until it finished."
            3. _poovarasan king_, Jul 20, 2026, 5/5: "I really like so much slice small finance Bank App_I have been using slice for almost 2 years more than now I can tell you this Easy transaction and Comparing Another credit app Silent app only less interest _ Silent bank Account seriously very good daily interest and Any UPI payment or Mobile recharge we no need to pay Extra Amount _ One time also we are not facing server issue also, really this slice app very useful in overall ..."
